descriptions.w3d_d30e_prune_voices_801dc7d8: Per-frame update of a sound object: returns 0x80004005 until ready (+176). Updates each listener in the array at +48 through virtual slot 10, steps each 16-byte gain entry in the vector at +60 with 0x801db06c, erasing finished ones (element copy with AddRef and Release, out-of-line destructor), then erases dead entries of the array at +76 (virtual slot 7). Names are inferred.
